descriptions.text: Crafting without punches? Inconceivable! Punches are a quick and easy way to add interest and depth to your projects. And there’s no better way to cut out stamped images—many of our stamp sets have coordinating punches. Our punches are high quality, affordable, and easy to use. Create your own tag toppers, bookmarks, and bellybands. Insert a 2" (5.1 cm) strip of cardstock (any length), and punch. * Sleek body style * Large surface area offers precise cutting and leverage * Locks to store * Slim and stackable

descriptions.text: The best projects start with the best products. Start your projects with our high-quality cardstock, formulated especially for discerning crafters. The ultrasmooth surface is ideal for stamping, so you get clean, crisp images. And it's dyed with pure color all the way through so there's no white core. * 24 sheets * Blackberry Bliss * 8-1/2" x 11" * Acid free * Lignin free

descriptions.text: Our Lost Lagoon 8-1/2" x 11" Cardstock is great for handmade cards and other paper crafts. It’s high quality, acid free, and lignin free, making it a favorite scrapbook paper too. This classic, heavyweight cardstock is dyed with pure color all the way through, so you won’t see any white edges when you cut or tear it. The ultrasmooth surface makes it an ideal paper for stamping, giving you clean, crisp images.
